info.title: API.SH: Firefox Add-ons
info.description: The Firefox Add-ons API from API.SH: public Firefox Add-ons data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One add-on with name, summary, full description, authors, categories, tags, daily users, weekly downloads, ratings with counts per star, badges, homepage and support links, screenshots, the current version (license, release notes, file size, permissions, host and data-collection permissions, compatibility), the EULA and the privacy policy.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/firefox-addons-addon

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Add-on slug, numeric id, GUID or addons.mozilla.org link.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language for names and descriptions (default en-US), e.g. de, fr, ja, pt-BR.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
User reviews of an add-on, newest first: star score, text, date, the version reviewed and the developer's reply. Filter by score or version, or keep only reviews with text. Each reviewer as the reviews page shows them: display name and public profile link. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/firefox-addons-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Add-on slug, numeric id, GUID or addons.mozilla.org link.

parameters.name: score
parameters.description: Only these star scores, 1-5 (comma list, e.g. 1,2).

parameters.name: with_text
parameters.description: true: only reviews with a written text.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Only reviews of this version id (from `/firefox-addons/v1/versions`).

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language for names and descriptions (default en-US), e.g. de, fr, ja, pt-BR.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1-50 (default 25).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Searches addons.mozilla.org for extensions, themes, dictionaries and language packs, with every filter the store offers (type, category, tag, author, promoted badge, theme color, minimum users) and every sort. Each add-on comes with authors, categories, daily users, weekly downloads, rating, badges, current version and dates. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/firefox-addons-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words (optional when a filter or sort is given).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Add-on type: `extension`, `statictheme`, `dictionary` or `language`.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug from `/firefox-addons/v1/categories` (needs `type`), e.g. privacy-security.

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Tag, e.g. privacy or youtube.

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Author username or user id (comma list for several).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default relevance with q, users without).

parameters.name: promoted
parameters.description: Only add-ons with this badge.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Themes with this main color (hex, e.g. 00ff00).

parameters.name: min_users
parameters.description: Only add-ons with more daily users than this.

parameters.name: guid
parameters.description: Look up add-ons by GUID (comma list).

parameters.name: exclude_addons
parameters.description: Add-on ids or slugs to leave out (comma list).

parameters.name: app
parameters.description: `firefox` (desktop, default) or `android`.

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Language for names and descriptions (default en-US), e.g. de, fr, ja, pt-BR.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1-50 (default 25).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
